messages:
Alex: FYI seeing a spike in fncall schema rejections on EU region since yesterday — looks like rollbacks are hitting the degen route and customers get charged. snippet:
```
[WARN] fncall.validate failed route=checkout-eu customer_id=org-42 validator_score=0.12 missing_field=items
```
Anyone else? :eyes:

Maria: Can you share the grafana query? I want per-route rejects and to confirm whether quota/billing attribution uses the original route or the fallback.

Alex: Current best-effort query I used locally:
```
sum by (route_id) (increase(fncall_validation_rejected_total[1h]))
```
But the metric today has no route label so it's aggregated :facepalm:

Sam: That's bad. Product question: do we want the Console to show "soft rejects" vs "hard rejects" and let SRE toggle enforcement per-tenant? Could help debugging without impacting billing.

Ana: Engineering: agree add labels: route_id, model_variant, billing_route. Also add reject_type low-cardinality tag: "hard" | "soft" | "parse_error". We'll also need a sampling flag for payload samples (PII redaction).

Alex: +1. For payloads we should hash sensitive fields and only store redacted JSON. Sampling rate at first 1/1000 per tenant, adjustable.

Maria: Dashboard idea: panel for rejects / 5m, reject_rate, top reject reasons, sample link. Query skeleton:
```
rate(fncall_validation_rejected_total[5m]) by (route_id, reject_type)
```
We can add grafana drilldown to sampled S3 objects (redacted).

ops-bot: deploy:canary validator-metrics-labels started by Ana — canary=10% :rocket:

Ana: Plan: add metric + labels, wire to ingest, then backfill approximate route for existing data. Add alert when reject_rate > 0.5% for 15m (start SEV2). We'll also add a non-billing soft-reject phase for 48h to monitor.

Sam: UX asks: Console should surface a per-route "validation health" score, and a quick action: "pause strict validation" per-tenant (needs audit log). I'll draft a mock.

Alex: I'll open PR for metric + redaction logic. Also will add a flag to stop billing on soft-rejects until we flip enforcement. PR: #4821

Maria: I'll make the dashboard (DASH-117) and add panels & runbooks.

Sam: Timeline check — can we get canary + dashboard in 48h?

Ana: Canary goes out in ~2h (small patch), dashboard in 24h, billing toggle in 72h. Splitting tasks and owners in Asana.

Alex: Filing follow-ups: PR #4821, DASH-117, OPS-ALERT-21. Thanks all.

Maria: added DASH-117 to backlog. :thumbsup:
